article.title: 進博會香港食品館首設名牌專區，集中展示品牌故事
article.title_en: CIIE’s Hong Kong food pavilion debuts a dedicated brand zone
article.summary: 香港貿發局設食品及服務業兩個展館，食品館首次劃出香港名牌專區。
article.summary_en: The HKTDC mounted food and services pavilions. The food pavilion introduced a dedicated Hong Kong brand zone.
highlights: 據中新社，食品館有37家企業，展示食品及飲品。
服務業展館集合34家參展商，涵蓋企業服務及物流等領域。
highlights_en: China News Service reports 37 food and beverage exhibitors in the food pavilion.
The services pavilion gathered 34 exhibitors, including business services and logistics.
article.why: 香港品牌可把產品特色和品牌來源放在同一陳列，方便買家了解定位，再接續渠道洽談。
article.why_en: Hong Kong brands can show product features alongside their origins, then continue the conversation with channel buyers.
article.next_step: 為參展商品整理規格、供貨及渠道條件，按買家類型安排展後跟進。
article.next_step_en: Prepare specifications, supply and channel terms and organise follow-up by buyer type.
article.detail: 中新社的現場報道舉出傳統餅家、醬園，以及把鹹檸七元素放入拉格啤酒的品牌，展示名牌專區如何同時容納歷史與新產品。食品館與服務業展館的參展數按企業計算，與整個進博會的港企總數口徑不同。展商可按零售、分銷或服務合作分類跟進，並保留買家對供貨與定價的實際問題。
article.detail_en: China News Service describes traditional bakeries, sauce makers and a lager inspired by salted lemon soda. Pavilion exhibitor counts differ from the total number of Hong Kong companies at CIIE. Classify retail, distribution and service leads separately and capture actual buyer questions on supply and pricing.
